hooks.command: input=$(cat); fp=$(printf '%s' "$input" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // ""'); [ -z "$fp" ] && exit 0; dir=$(dirname "$fp"); branch=$(git -C "$dir" branch --show-current 2>/dev/null); if [ "$branch" = "main" ] || [ "$branch" = "master" ]; then echo "BLOCKED: editing on the main branch is not allowed in this repo. Create an isolated worktree first with the EnterWorktree tool (it branches a feature branch from origin/main), then edit inside it. See CLAUDE.md > Worktree Workflow." >&2; exit 2; fi; exit 0
